== Notes ==
* This skill increases all forms of healing, including the [[Divine Favor]] bonus. It does not affect non-healing forms of [[health gain]] like [[life stealing]]. For details, see [[Heal#Healing modifiers|healing modifiers]].
{{ anomaly|Similar to [[Flurry]], the damage reduction only applies to the equipped [[weapon]]'s base damage. It will not reduce damage dealt by skills or effects, not even bonus damage from [[attack skill]]s.}}
